name: What are the benefits of hiring a specialized garage conversion contractor versus a general contractor?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of hiring a specialized garage conversion contractor versus a general contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hiring a contractor specializing in garage conversions often brings advantages like deeper expertise in specific challenges such as structural reinforcement, utility integration, and navigating ADU regulations. They are typically more efficient with permitting processes and have established relationships with relevant subcontractors. While a general contractor can also perform the work, a specialist may offer more streamlined processes, specialized knowledge, and potentially faster project completion due to their focused experience.
acceptedAnswer.description: Specialized garage conversion contractors offer deeper expertise in specific challenges, streamlined processes, and faster completion compared to general contractors.
